narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The jump must be a multiple of both numbers, so it is huge!
<bookmark mark='hop'/>A jump of one hundred and fifty lands first on one hundred and fifty.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It flies past thirty and fifty, so it lands on neither.

<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Treasures sit on thirty four and fifty one. Find the longest jump that lands on both.
